verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking-and-relevance guide has sections on 'Promoting or Hiding Results (Merchandising)' and 'Boosting / Burying sets of records', and a dedicated curation API page exists. Together these cover pinning, boosting and hiding hits. Nothing in the pack mentions synonyms, and the curation evidence is only section headings with no detail on per-query rules. Missing for 10: any evidence of synonym definition support, detailed documentation of per-query pin/hide rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of curation.
